create_go_to_k_targets_env: create a go_to_k_targets environment where an Ant walker navigates to k target positions
create_move_box_env: create a move_box environment where an Ant walker pushes a box to a target position
create_move_box_or_gtt_env: create a move_box_or_gtt environment combining box pushing and go-to-target predicates randomly
create_move_box_and_gtt_env: create a move_box_and_gtt environment requiring both box pushing and go-to-target predicates simultaneously
create_predicate_task_env: create a custom predicate task environment with configurable boxes, targets, and predicate types
